title: Retrieve, Reproduce, Reveal: Dissecting Retrieval-Augmented Software Vulnerability Detection
title_zh: Retrieval, Reproduce, Reveal: 解构检索增强的软件漏洞检测

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly used to enhance Large Language Model (LLM)-based software vulnerability detection by grounding predictions in retrieved vulnerability knowledge, such as vulnerability reports. However, existing RAG-based software vulnerability detection (RAG4SVD) systems are often evaluated using proprietary models, which challenges open science and reproducibility. Further, studies use different datasets, custom knowledge bases, different backbone models, and diverse metrics, which hinders meaningful cross-system comparison. In this work, we study six open-source RAG4SVD systems and address these reproducibility and comparability challenges through (i) reproduction of their experimental settings under an open-weight setting, and (ii) a unified benchmark using a common dataset, metric suite, and pool of open-weight models. Further, RAG4SVD systems typically consist of multiple components, yet are often evaluated only as a whole system, i.e., end-to-end. Therefore, we perform (iii) a component-level analysis that decomposes representative RAG4SVD pipelines into input abstraction, knowledge retrieval, and detection. Our results demonstrate that reproducibility varies substantially across systems. Under the presented unified benchmark, published RAG4SVD performance does not transfer under a controlled open-weight evaluation and depends strongly on the used model. The component analysis shows that effective RAG4SVD depends on the alignment between pipeline stages. For example, oracle knowledge raises retrieval to near-optimal, yet performance remains low ( 0.51 0.51 pairwise accuracy), demonstrating that retrieval effectiveness alone is insufficient for reliable detection. These findings motivate evaluating RAG4SVD not only end-to-end, but at the level of pipeline components, and provide a basis for more standardized, RAG-aware evaluation practices.

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to software vulnerability detection by leveraging their code-understanding and reasoning capabilities to discover insecure code ( Kaniewski et al., 2026a ) . However, an LLM’s internal knowledge is inherently limited by its training data and respective cutoff date. Thus, newly disclosed vulnerabilities, emerging attack patterns, and project-specific security knowledge that were published after the training cutoff date may be unavailable to the model at inference time. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) addresses this limitation by dynamically retrieving external vulnerability knowledge, e.g., Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) descriptions, specific Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) reports, or similar vulnerable code examples, from a knowledge base and incorporating it into the prompt ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Unlike costly retraining or fine-tuning, the knowledge base can be updated independently of the model to add more specific and up-to-date information and, thus, enhance detection performance.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地应用于软件漏洞检测，通过利用其对代码的理解和推理能力来发现不安全代码（Kaniewski 等人，2026a）。 然而，LLM 的内部知识本质上受其训练数据和相应的截止日期所限制。 因此，在训练截止日期之后发布的新披露漏洞、新兴攻击模式以及特定项目的安全知识，在推理时可能无法被模型获取。 检索增强生成（RAG）（Lewis 等人，2020）通过动态从知识库中检索外部漏洞知识来解决这一限制，例如常见弱点枚举（CWE）描述、特定的常见漏洞与暴露（CVE）报告或类似的脆弱代码示例，并将其融入提示中（Chen 等人，2026）。 与代价高昂的重训练或微调不同，知识库可以独立于模型进行更新，以添加更具体和最新的信息，从而提升检测性能。

paragraphs.en: The adoption of RAG for LLM-based software vulnerability detection (RAG4SVD) has grown rapidly, with proposed RAG systems reporting improvements over non-retrieval baselines ( Du et al., 2025 ; Kaniewski et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . RAG4SVD systems typically follow a common pipeline, cf. Fig. 1 : The code under analysis is first transformed via input abstraction into the representation used to query the knowledge base, e.g., the raw code itself or a semantic summary of the code. This query is passed to a knowledge retrieval mechanism, e.g., based on embedding similarity, lexical matching, structured lookup, or a hybrid combination thereof, which retrieves relevant entries. Finally, the retrieved knowledge is combined with the code under analysis and passed to the LLM for detection , producing a vulnerability prediction, e.g., a binary vulnerable/non-vulnerable label.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的软件漏洞检测中，检索增强生成（RAG）技术（即 RAG4SVD）的应用迅速普及。已提出的 RAG 系统报告称，其性能优于非检索类基线方法（Du et al., 2025；Kaniewski et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026）。RAG4SVD 系统通常遵循一个通用流程，参见图 1：首先，待分析的代码通过输入抽象转换为用于查询知识库的表示形式，例如原始代码本身或代码的语义摘要。随后，该查询被送入知识检索机制（例如基于嵌入相似性、词汇匹配、结构化查找或这些方法的混合组合），以检索相关条目。最后，检索到的知识与待分析代码相结合，并传入 LLM 进行检测，从而生成漏洞预测结果，例如“存在漏洞/不存在漏洞”的二元标签。

paragraphs.en: Yet, it remains unclear how generalizable reported gains are. First, results are rarely independently verified ( Kaniewski et al., 2026b ) . Incomplete public artifacts, undocumented preprocessing and dependencies, non-deterministic inference, and reliance on proprietary models or APIs further complicate reproducing LLM-based systems ( Sallou et al., 2024 ; HS Esslingen IT Security, 2026 ; Kaniewski et al., 2026b ) . Model providers may discontinue or modify their models without notice, which renders experiments non-reproducible. Second, systems differ substantially in their datasets, knowledge bases, query representations, retrieval mechanisms, and backbone models ( Kaniewski et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Consequently, results across individual studies do not provide a basis for comparing different systems. Third, despite the fact that these systems consist of multiple components, they are commonly evaluated only through their final detection accuracy, i.e., end-to-end. It is often unclear if improvements stem from the quality and coverage of the knowledge base, the abstraction used to formulate a retrieval query, the retrieval mechanism, or the capabilities of the detection model used. paragraphs.en: To address these gaps, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first study in RAG-based software vulnerability detection to jointly assess reproducibility, cross-system performance, and individual pipeline components. The contributions of this work are threefold: (i) Considering six open-source RAG4SVD systems, i.e., SVD-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , Llama-VD 1 1 1 We introduce the abbreviation Llama-VD in this work for brevity. ( Ouchebara and Dupont, 2025 ) , GRACE ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , LLM4Vuln ( Sun et al., 2025b ) , Vul-RAG ( Du et al., 2025 ) , and VulTriage ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , we first reproduce systems using open-weight models and quantify deviations from their reported results. (ii) Second, we analyze how the considered RAG4SVD systems compare when re-implemented under a common dataset, metric suite, and pool of heterogeneous open-weight models, enabling controlled comparison across independently proposed systems. (iii) Third, we move beyond end-to-end evaluation and dissect representative multi-stage RAG4SVD pipelines into input abstraction , knowledge retrieval , and detection , proposing a component-aware evaluation of RAG4SVD systems. Specifically, we evaluate whether generated abstractions preserve information useful for retrieval, whether relevant knowledge is actually retrieved, and whether oracle knowledge improves the detection performance. Together, these analyses provide a RAG-aware evaluation that examines not whether RAG improves vulnerability detection, but which components drive performance. The replication package for this study is publicly available at https://github.com/hs-esslingen-it-security/RAG4SVD .

sents.zh: 具体而言，我们评估了生成的抽象信息是否保留了有助于检索的关键信息、相关知识是否确实被检索到，以及“神谕”知识是否能提升检测性能。

sents.en: Together, these analyses provide a RAG-aware evaluation that examines not whether RAG improves vulnerability detection, but which components drive performance.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些分析提供了一种基于 RAG 的评估方法，该方法不仅考察 RAG 是否提升了漏洞检测能力，更关注具体哪些组件推动了性能表现。

paragraphs.en: Research on LLM-based software vulnerability detection has expanded rapidly in recent years ( Kaniewski et al., 2026a ) . In this section, we review prior work on (i) benchmarking LLM-based software vulnerability detection, (ii) benchmarking RAG-based software vulnerability detection approaches, and (iii) component-level evaluation of RAG pipelines, positioning the contributions of this work.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的软件漏洞检测研究迅速扩展（Kaniewski 等人，2026a）。 在本节中，我们将回顾以下三项先前的工作：(i) 基于 LLM 的软件漏洞检测基准测试，(ii) 基于检索增强生成（RAG）的软件漏洞检测方法基准测试，以及 (iii) RAG 流程的组件级评估，从而明确本研究的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Several works benchmark how different prompting and tuning strategies affect vulnerability detection performance ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Steenhoek et al., 2025 ; Tamberg and Bahsi, 2025 ; Ullah et al., 2024 ) . For example, Steenhoek et al. ( Steenhoek et al., 2025 ) systematically compare prompting strategies, including in-context learning, few-shot, and Chain-of-Thought prompting, and Zhang et al. ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) compare prompt engineering, instruction tuning, and sequence-classification fine-tuning across programming languages and model sizes. However, none of these efforts extend to different RAG-based systems, which introduce an additional layer of design choices, such as knowledge base construction or retrieval strategy, on top of existing evaluation challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 多项研究对不同的提示和微调策略如何影响漏洞检测性能进行了基准测试（Zhang 等人，2025；Steenhoek 等人，2025；Tamberg 和 Bahsi，2025；Ullah 等人，2024）。 例如，Steenhoek 等人 （Steenhoek 等人，2025）系统性地比较了多种提示策略，包括上下文学习、少样本提示和思维链提示，而 Zhang 等人 （Zhang 等人，2025）则在不同编程语言和模型规模下，对提示工程、指令调优和序列分类微调进行了比较。 然而，这些研究均未扩展到不同的基于 RAG 的系统，而这些系统除了现有的评估挑战外，还引入了额外的设计选择，例如知识库构建或检索策略。

paragraphs.en: Recent works further question whether reported performance reflects genuine detection capability of LLMs or is instead an artifact of the datasets and evaluation protocols used ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Steenhoek et al., 2025 ; Ullah et al., 2024 ) . Ding et al. ( Ding et al., 2025 ) show that established benchmarks such as BigVul ( Fan et al., 2020 ) overestimate model performance due to, e.g., noisy labels and high duplication rates ( Guo and Bettaieb, 2023 ) . To address these issues, they introduce an improved vulnerability dataset PrimeVul , which combines rigorous de-duplication and human-verified labeling with a stricter pairwise evaluation protocol. Under this more realistic setting, reported F1 scores for state-of-the-art code language models dropped to as low as 0.03 0.03 , motivating a shift toward PrimeVul as the de facto benchmark for LLM-based software vulnerability detection, which we also adopt as a common benchmark dataset. Further, we assess multiple detection models across systems, allowing us to distinguish gains attributable to model capacity from gains attributable to the RAG system architectures. In doing so, we extend prior LLM benchmarking from model-centric evaluation to system-level evaluation of RAG-based vulnerability detection.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究进一步质疑了所报告的性能是否真正反映了大型语言模型（LLM）的实际检测能力，或者仅仅是所用数据集和评估协议造成的结果（Ding 等人，2025；Steenhoek 等人，2025；Ullah 等人，2024）。Ding 等人 （Ding 等人，2025）指出，像 BigVul（Fan 等人，2020）这样的成熟基准测试会高估模型性能，原因包括标签噪声和高度重复的数据（Guo 和 Bettaieb，2023）。 为解决这些问题，他们引入了一个改进的漏洞数据集 PrimeVul，该数据集结合了严格的去重处理和人工验证的标签，并采用了更严格的成对评估协议。 在这种更贴近现实的设定下，当前最先进的代码语言模型所报告的 F1 分数降至低至 0.03，这促使人们转向将 PrimeVul 作为 LLM  기반 软件漏洞检测的事实基准，我们也将它用作共同的基准数据集。 此外，我们对多个系统上的多种检测模型进行了评估，从而能够区分出哪些性能提升源于模型容量，哪些则源于 RAG 系统架构。 通过这样做，我们将以往以模型为中心的 LLM 基准测试扩展到了对基于 RAG 的漏洞检测的系统级评估。

paragraphs.en: Existing RAG-based software vulnerability detection systems are predominantly evaluated in isolation, often using custom evaluation protocols, making direct comparisons difficult ( Kaniewski et al., 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: Kaniewski et al. ( Kaniewski et al., 2026b ) provide an initial reproducibility and replicability study of Vul-RAG ( Du et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by the dependence of many LLM-based approaches on proprietary models, the authors adapt the Vul-RAG pipeline to an open-weight setting and first reproduce its reported open-weight baselines before evaluating a broader set of LLMs. However, the study scope is intentionally restricted to a single RAG4SVD system and primarily investigates reproducibility and model replicability; it does not compare multiple proposed RAG architectures, transfer them to a new dataset, or evaluate individual pipeline components.

paragraphs.en: This fragmentation is further highlighted by Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Surveying 30 RAG-based studies across the software vulnerability lifecycle, they highlight that evaluation practices remain fragmented across datasets, baselines, models, and metrics. We address this gap: to the best of our knowledge, we present the first reproducibility assessment and benchmark for RAG4SVD, applying a common dataset, metric suite, and model pool across systems to make reported gains comparable.

( Chen et al., 2026 ) further highlight that RAG-specific properties such as retrieval quality, grounding, and faithfulness remain insufficiently evaluated.

paragraphs.en: Component-wise evaluation of RAG pipelines has been explored for selected software engineering tasks. Ke et al. ( Ke et al., 2026 ) present a component-wise empirical study that systematically isolates and evaluates four query processing techniques, seven retrieval models, four context refinement methods, and six generators across the code generation, summarization, and repair tasks. However, their evaluation focuses on extrinsic performance: every component is judged solely by its effect on final task performance, but never assessed individually (e.g., whether retrieved knowledge is relevant). We address this gap by expanding extrinsic evaluation with intrinsic evaluation. paragraphs.en: GRACE ( Lu et al., 2024 ) uses dense retrieval, embedding the function under analysis and training functions with CodeT5 to retrieve semantically similar candidates. These candidates are subsequently re-ranked using lexical token overlap and syntactic similarity derived from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) representations to select a single example. paragraphs.en: LLM4Vuln ( Sun et al., 2025b ) presents a modular evaluation framework that separates an LLM’s intrinsic vulnerability reasoning from external enhancements, including knowledge retrieval, program-context supplementation, and prompting. For knowledge retrieval, it uses dense retrieval with text-embedding-ada-002 , supporting either the raw source code or an LLM-generated functionality summary (semantic abstraction) as the query representation. The top- 3 3 most similar entries are retrieved, and their associated raw or summarized vulnerability knowledge, including vulnerability descriptions and root causes, is supplied to the LLM for detection.

paragraphs.en: Vul-RAG ( Du et al., 2025 ) retrieves abstract, vulnerability-specific knowledge distilled from vulnerable-patched code pairs. Its knowledge base represents each vulnerability through functional semantics, vulnerability causes, and corresponding patches. At inference, an LLM generates an abstract purpose and detailed behavioral description of the code under analysis; Vul-RAG uses these together with the raw code as three retrieval queries. It applies sparse BM25 retrieval, which ranks entries by lexical term matching, and combines the resulting candidate lists using reciprocal rank fusion. The retrieved items are then examined sequentially by the LLM to determine whether the code exhibits a retrieved vulnerability cause without the corresponding patch behavior.
paragraphs.zh: Vul-RAG（Du 等人，2025）从包含漏洞与修复的代码对中提取抽象的、针对特定漏洞的知识。 其知识库通过功能语义、漏洞成因及对应的修复方案来表征每个漏洞。 在推理阶段，一个大语言模型会生成待分析代码的抽象目的和详细行为描述；Vul-RAG 将这些内容与原始代码一同用作三个检索查询。 它采用稀疏 BM25 检索方法，通过词汇项匹配对条目进行排序，并使用倒数排名融合法合并生成的候选列表。 随后，大语言模型会依次检查检索到的条目，以确定代码是否表现出已检索到的漏洞成因，但缺少对应的修复行为。

paragraphs.en: VulTriage ( Tang et al., 2026 ) augments vulnerability detection through three complementary context paths targeting program structure, program semantics, and vulnerability knowledge. For knowledge retrieval, it generates up to two coarse natural-language vulnerability predictions of the code under analysis in a first step and uses these predictions as queries to a CWE-derived knowledge base. It performs hybrid retrieval by combining dense semantic similarity using bge-m3 embeddings with sparse lexical matching. The retrieved CWE descriptions and code examples are then combined with the code under analysis, structural context, and semantic summary for the final prediction.
paragraphs.zh: VulTriage（Tang 等人，2026）通过三条互补的上下文路径增强了漏洞检测能力，这些路径分别针对程序结构、程序语义和漏洞知识。 在知识检索方面，它首先生成最多两条关于所分析代码的大致自然语言漏洞预测，并将这些预测作为查询，用于一个基于 CWE 的知识库。 它通过结合使用 bge-m3 嵌入向量实现的密集语义相似性与稀疏词汇匹配，执行混合检索。 随后，检索到的 CWE 描述和代码示例会与所分析代码、结构上下文以及语义摘要相结合，以生成最终预测。

paragraphs.en: In the evaluation, we distinguish between the original datasets used by each vulnerability detection system and a common dataset used for cross-system comparison. For RQ1, we retain each system’s original dataset and data split (including the system-specific knowledge base) to reproduce its reported performance. For the unified benchmark (RQ2), we use PrimeVul ( Ding et al., 2025 ) as the common dataset. PrimeVul was introduced to address limitations of earlier vulnerability datasets, particularly noisy labels, duplicate samples, and data leakage across training and evaluation sets ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . The full dataset (v0.1) contains 6,968 vulnerable and 228,800 benign functions spanning 94 CWEs and employs a chronological train, validation, and test split. For the benchmark, we specifically use the paired subset of PrimeVul, i.e., PrimeVul Paired : each vulnerable function is matched with its corresponding patch, resulting in 5480 pairs across 88 CWEs, making it particularly suitable for evaluating whether a model can correctly distinguish vulnerable code from its patched counterpart. We use the train split as the basis for the knowledge base and the test split for testing. For the component analysis in RQ3, specifically the knowledge retrieval, we additionally construct test set probes, i.e., randomly sample from the test sets (see Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Detection Performance. We assess detection performance using the standard classification metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-score. While these metrics quantify performance at the level of individual functions, they do not capture whether a model can distinguish a vulnerable function from its patched non-vulnerable counterpart. Following the pairwise evaluation protocol introduced for PrimeVul ( Ding et al., 2025 ) , we report Pairwise Accuracy ( Du et al., 2025 ) . A vulnerability-patch pair is counted as correctly classified only if the vulnerable instance is predicted as vulnerable and its corresponding patched instance is predicted as non-vulnerable: Pair . Acc . = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N 𝟏 ​ ( y ^ i vuln = 1 ∧ y ^ i patch = 0 ) \mathrm{Pair.\,Acc.}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathbf{1}(\hat{y}^{\mathrm{vuln}}_{i}=1\land\hat{y}^{\mathrm{patch}}_{i}=0) , where N N denotes the number of pairs. Since paired instances differ primarily in the security-relevant changes introduced by the patch, this metric provides a stricter test of whether a model correctly distinguishes vulnerable from patched code.

paragraphs.en: Several of the considered RAG4SVD systems originally rely on proprietary models, e.g., GPT-4 ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ) , or use open-weight models of scales typically requiring API services, e.g., DeepSeek-V3 ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025b ) with 685 685 B parameters. For the unified evaluation, we select a common pool of 22 22 open-weight models from 7 7 model families: Qwen ( Qwen et al., 2025 ; Hui et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Qwen, 2026a ; Qwen, 2026b ; Qwen, 2025 ) , Llama ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Phi ( Abdin et al., 2024 ; Microsoft et al., 2025 ) , Gemma ( Team et al., 2025 ) , NextCoder ( Aggarwal et al., 2025 ) , DeepSeek ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025a ) , and Mistral ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) . The pool spans parameter scales from approximately 3 3 B to 32 32 B, deliberately focusing on scales that remain amenable to practical local and on-premises deployment. The selection further includes both general-purpose and code-specialized models. Where available, we include multiple parameter scales from the same family, allowing us to additionally examine the effect of model scale. Unless otherwise stated, we use the full model pool consistently across experiments. The complete model lineup and checkpoints are reported in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: Minor implementation changes were necessary to accommodate differences between proprietary and open-weight models. In particular, some open-weight models do not always adhere as reliably to requested output formats, e.g., requiring <result>YES/NO<\result> tags ( Du et al., 2025 ) , which requires more robust parsing of generated responses. We therefore hardened system-specific output parsers where necessary to tolerate formatting variations without changing the semantic interpretation of model outputs. Detailed system-specific changes are documented in the replication package.
paragraphs.zh: 为了适应专有模型与开放权重模型之间的差异，需要进行一些微小的实现调整。 特别地，某些开放权重模型并不总能可靠地遵循所要求的输出格式，例如要求使用 <result>YES/NO<\result> 标签（Du et al., 2025），这需要对生成的响应进行更稳健的解析。 因此，我们在必要时强化了系统特定的输出解析器，使其能够容忍格式差异，而无需改变模型输出的语义解释。 详细的系统特定变更已在复现包中记录。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we report the empirical evaluation of the considered RAG4SVD systems, structured around the derived research questions RQ1-RQ3. We first determine whether reported results can be reproduced (RQ1), then compare reproducible systems using a unified benchmark (RQ2), and finally isolate individual RAG components (RQ3).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们围绕已推导出的研究问题 RQ1-RQ3，报告所考虑的 RAG4SVD 系统的实证评估结果。 我们首先确定报告的结果是否可以复现（RQ1），然后使用统一的基准对可复现的系统进行比较（RQ2），最后隔离各个 RAG 组件（RQ3）。

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility is a prerequisite for meaningful benchmarking. If systems cannot be faithfully reproduced, differences observed in subsequent comparisons may reflect implementation artifacts rather than underlying methods. For RQ1, we focus on systems that report results for at least one open-weight model. This criterion includes SVD-Bench, Llama-VD, LLM4Vuln, and Vul-RAG, while excluding GRACE and VulTriage, whose evaluations rely exclusively on proprietary models.
paragraphs.zh: 可复现性是有意义的基准测试的先决条件。 如果系统无法被忠实地复现，后续比较中观察到的差异可能反映的是实现细节，而非底层方法本身。 对于研究问题一（RQ1），我们重点关注至少报告了一种开放权重模型结果的系统。 这一标准涵盖了 SVD-Bench、Llama-VD、LLM4Vuln 和 Vul-RAG，但排除了 GRACE 和 VulTriage，因为它们的评估完全依赖专有模型。

paragraphs.en: For the considered systems, we assess whether the reported results can be reproduced in a local open-weight inference setting . Where a study evaluates multiple datasets or models, we reproduce these settings separately. We repeat each experiment three times to account for inference variability; results are averaged across runs. Following Nong et al. ( Nong et al., 2023 ) , we quantify reproducibility using the absolute relative deviation between reproduced and reported results. Deviations below 1 % 1\% , between 1 % 1\% and 5 % 5\% , and above 5 % 5\% are classified as reproducible, weakly reproducible, and not reproducible, respectively. Fig. 3 summarizes the results across all considered systems.
paragraphs.zh: 对于所研究的系统，我们评估了报告的结果是否能够在本地开放权重推理环境中复现。如果某项研究评估了多个数据集或模型，我们会分别对这些设置进行复现。为考虑推理过程中的变异性，我们对每个实验重复三次；结果取各次运行的平均值。遵循 Nong 等人（Nong et al., 2023）的方法，我们通过复现结果与报告结果之间的绝对相对偏差来量化可复现性。偏差低于 1%、介于 1% 和 5% 之间，以及高于 5% 的情况，分别被归类为“可复现”、“弱可复现”和“不可复现”。图 3 总结了所有所研究系统的结果。

Reproducibility does not hold consistently across this language coverage: deviations exceed 5 % 5\% for Python and Java, while selected JavaScript metrics fall within the weakly reproducible range. The largest deviation occurs for recall on the Python dataset ( 58.2 % 58.2\% ), indicating that the reproduced implementation does not recover the reported performance.

paragraphs.en: LLM4Vuln. LLM4Vuln reports results for different detection models, including three open-weight models, but still relies on GPT-4.1 for summary generation and output evaluation and, thus, cannot be reproduced with its original configuration in a fully open-weight reproduction setting. We therefore substitute these components with open-weight alternatives. We chose the substitutes (summary: Qwen3-4B, judge: Gemma-3-27B) through an ablation of candidate models based on their error rate and ability to produce correctly parseable outputs (cf. replication package). Despite using the closest-performing substitutes, the reproduced results deviate by more than 5 % 5\% from the reported results, rendering LLM4Vuln not reproducible under a fully open-weight setting. Unlike the other considered systems, this deviation is not attributable to, e.g., parsing or inference variance alone, since LLM4Vuln depends on unavailable proprietary components. The reported results here reflect a model substitution rather than a reproduction of the original configuration, making a deviation from the reported results expected.
paragraphs.zh: LLM4Vuln。 LLM4Vuln 报告了不同检测模型的结果，其中包括三个开源模型，但仍依赖 GPT-4.1 进行摘要生成和输出评估，因此无法在完全开源的重现环境中使用其原始配置进行复现。 因此，我们用开源的替代方案替换了这些组件。 我们通过基于候选模型的错误率以及生成可正确解析输出的能力（参见复现包）进行了消融分析，并据此选择了替代模型（摘要：Qwen3-4B，评判器：Gemma-3-27B）。 尽管使用了性能最接近的替代模型，但复现结果与报告结果仍存在超过 5 % 5\% 的偏差，这使得 LLM4Vuln 在完全开源的设置下无法复现。 与其他所考虑的系统不同，这种偏差并非仅由解析或推理差异引起，因为 LLM4Vuln 依赖无法获取的专有组件。 此处报告的结果反映的是模型替换，而非原始配置的复现，因此与报告结果出现偏差是意料之中的。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the considered systems under a common dataset, metric suite, and model pool to enable a controlled cross-system comparison. Notably, we are not estimating each system’s best possible performance; we assess how the systems transfer under a controlled open-weight environment. Accordingly, we exclude LLM4Vuln from the unified benchmark. LLM4Vuln’s modular pipeline relies on GPT-4.1 for summarization and judge-based evaluation such that evaluating it in an open-weight inference setting would require model substitutions, which introduces confounds beyond the choice of detection backbone. To further separate detection performance from parsing failures and prompt-specific instruction-following issues, we report a configuration only if at least 95% of pairs yield a correctly parsed prediction.

paragraphs.en: Backbone Sensitivity. Performance varies markedly with the underlying detection model, but we observe no consistent advantage through model scale or code specialization where model families match. Within the Qwen2.5 family, for example, performance does not increase monotonically with parameter scale across systems, and the corresponding coder variants do not systematically outperform their general-purpose counterparts. Instead, the strongest backbone is pipeline-specific.

paragraphs.en: Parsing Robustness. The benchmark additionally exposes substantial differences in output-format robustness across systems. GRACE and Llama-VD yield sufficiently parseable predictions across the evaluated model pool. In contrast, VulTriage, which reports SOTA pairwise accuracy of 0.34 0.34 using GPT-4o on PrimeVul Paired ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , meets the 95% parsing threshold for only 5 5 tested open-weight models, indicating limited transferability of its prompting and output-format beyond the original proprietary-model setting. Instruction following and detection performance should therefore be treated as distinct system properties: a pipeline may perform well for a compatible backbone while remaining difficult to evaluate reliably with others due to prompt or output-format sensitivity.
paragraphs.zh: 解析鲁棒性。 该基准测试还揭示了不同系统在输出格式鲁棒性方面存在显著差异。 GRACE 和 Llama-VD 在所有受评估的模型中都能生成足够可解析的预测结果。 相比之下，VulTriage 在 PrimeVul Paired 数据集上使用 GPT-4o 报告了 0.34 的 SOTA 成对准确率（Tang et al., 2026），但仅在 5 个经过测试的开放权重模型中达到了 95% 的解析阈值，这表明其提示和输出格式在原始专有模型设置之外的迁移能力有限。 因此，指令遵循和检测性能应被视为独立的系统特性：一个流程可能在兼容的主干模型上表现良好，但由于对提示或输出格式的敏感性，在其他模型上可能难以可靠评估。

paragraphs.en: RAG4SVD pipelines combine multiple components, e.g., input abstraction, knowledge retrieval, and retrieval-augmented detection, as shown in Fig. 1 . However, prior work typically reports only end-to-end detection performance, leaving open which components drive the observed improvements. We complement the extrinsic evaluation in RQ2 with an intrinsic analysis that isolates and evaluates individual pipeline components. For this analysis, we focus on Vul-RAG ( Du et al., 2025 ) and LLM4Vuln ( Sun et al., 2025b ) , as both systems expose separable abstraction, retrieval, and detection stages and use retrieved knowledge as primary external augmentation, which facilitates component-level attribution.
paragraphs.zh: RAG4SVD 流程结合了多个组件，例如输入抽象、知识检索和检索增强检测，如图 1 所示。 然而，先前的工作通常仅报告端到端的检测性能，因此哪些组件导致了观察到的改进这一问题仍悬而未决。 我们通过内在分析来补充 RQ2 中的外在评估，该分析能够隔离并评估流程中的各个独立组件。 在此分析中，我们重点关注 Vul-RAG（Du et al., 2025）和 LLM4Vuln（Sun et al., 2025b），因为这两个系统都暴露了可分离的抽象、检索和检测阶段，并且都将检索到的知识作为主要的外部增强手段，这有助于进行组件级别的归因分析。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate the quality of input abstractions, i.e., whether using summaries of code functionality preserves information necessary for retrieval. Following prior work on LLM-based code summarization evaluation ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025a ; Song et al., 2024 ; Crupi et al., 2025 ) , we use an LLM-as-a-Judge and assess each summary along five dimensions. Four of these dimensions capture established summary-quality properties: Faithfulness (support by the input code), Functional Coverage (coverage of the code’s primary behavior), Conciseness (informativeness without unnecessary detail), and Clarity (readability and unambiguity). For the RAG setting, we additionally introduce Retrieval Utility , which assesses whether the summary preserves discriminative semantic information for retrieving relevant knowledge. Each dimension is scored from 1 to 5. Consistent with the focus on open-weight evaluation and following Li et al. ( Li et al., 2026 ) , we use GPT-oss-120B as the judge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先评估输入抽象的质量，即使用代码功能摘要是否保留了检索所需的信息。 遵循先前关于基于 LLM 的代码摘要评估的研究（Wu et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2025a；Song et al., 2024；Crupi et al., 2025），我们采用“LLM 作为裁判”的方法，并从五个维度评估每个摘要。 其中四个维度体现了公认的摘要质量特性：忠实性（由输入代码支持）、功能覆盖性（覆盖代码的主要行为）、简洁性（信息丰富且无冗余细节）和清晰度（可读性强且无歧义）。 在 RAG 设置中，我们额外引入了“检索效用”，用于评估摘要是否保留了检索相关知识所需的区分性语义信息。 每个维度的评分范围是 1 到 5。 与开放权重评估的重点一致，并遵循 Li et al. （Li et al., 2026）的研究，我们使用 GPT-oss-120B 作为裁判模型。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 visualizes judge-assessed summary quality across the model pool. Vul-RAG summaries score consistently high in Faithfulness, Functional Coverage, and Retrieval Utility, but lower in Conciseness. By contrast, LLM4Vuln summaries are generally more concise and clear, but provide less Functional Coverage and Retrieval Utility. This difference reflects the prompt objectives: Vul-RAG emphasizes purpose and functionality, whereas LLM4Vuln explicitly favors short summaries. Within each system, mean scores remain largely stable across dimensions and test sets. These results suggest that judged abstraction quality is driven more strongly by the system-specific summarization prompt than by the code to be summarized.

paragraphs.en: As a high-quality code summary can read well without necessarily helping vulnerability knowledge retrieval, we examine retrieval in practice. Therefore, we evaluate each knowledge base from two complementary perspectives: Knowledge Coverage and Retrieval Effectiveness . Knowledge coverage assesses whether the knowledge base contains knowledge relevant to the vulnerable codes represented in the test set, e.g., CWE type alignment. Retrieval effectiveness measures whether the retriever can successfully identify this relevant knowledge, quantified using Hit@ k k and MRR. Separating these two dimensions allows us to identify retrieval failures caused by missing knowledge alignment and those caused by ineffective retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 由于高质量的代码摘要虽然易于阅读，但并不一定能帮助检索漏洞相关知识，因此我们考察了实际中的检索效果。 因此，我们从两个互补的视角对每个知识库进行评估：知识覆盖率和检索有效性。 知识覆盖率评估的是知识库是否包含与测试集中所代表的脆弱代码相关的知识，例如 CWE 类型的对应关系。 检索有效性衡量的是检索器能否成功识别这些相关知识，并使用 Hit@k 和 MRR 进行量化。 将这两个维度分开，使我们能够识别出由知识对应缺失导致的检索失败，以及由检索无效导致的检索失败。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge Coverage. Vul-RAG constructs the knowledge base from historical CVEs, extracting functional semantics, vulnerability causes, and fixing solutions using GPT-3.5 ( Du et al., 2025 ) . The system targets 10 10 CWEs from the Linux kernel and maintains a dedicated knowledge base and test set for each CWE. By construction, the knowledge base and test data are aligned. Vul-RAG also allows for simple regeneration of the knowledge base. LLM4Vuln uses a generic knowledge base generated from CWE descriptions ( Sun et al., 2025b ) : GPT-4.1 generates 10 10 code examples for each of 92 92 6 6 6 The original LLM4Vuln paper reports 86 86 CWE categories. Using the publicly available code and configuration, we identified 92 92 distinct CWE categories. CWEs, and further summarizes functionality and root cause. While this design aims to provide generic vulnerability coverage, the knowledge base is weakly aligned with the curated test data. Specifically, only 6 6 of the 92 92 CWEs present in the knowledge base overlap with the 23 23 CWEs covered in the UniVul test set, which align with only 60 60 of 920 920 entries (less than 7 % 7\% ).
paragraphs.zh: 知识覆盖范围。 Vul-RAG 基于历史 CVE 构建知识库，利用 GPT-3.5（Du et al., 2025）提取功能语义、漏洞成因及修复方案。 该系统针对 Linux 内核中的 10 个 CWE，并为每个 CWE 维护独立的知识库和测试集。 根据构建方式，知识库与测试数据是相互对齐的。 Vul-RAG 还支持对知识库进行简单的重新生成。 LLM4Vuln 使用一个通用知识库，该知识库由 CWE 描述生成（Sun et al., 2025b）：GPT-4.1 为 92 个 CWE 中的每个 CWE 生成了 10 个代码示例（原文中数字重复，按原样保留）。 利用公开可用的代码和配置，我们识别出了 92 个不同的 CWE 类别。 这些 CWE，并进一步总结了其功能与根本原因。 尽管该设计旨在提供通用的漏洞覆盖，但知识库与精心挑选的测试数据之间的对齐程度较弱。 具体而言，知识库中存在的 92 个 CWE 里仅有 6 个与 UniVul 测试集涵盖的 23 个 CWE 重叠，而后者仅与 920 条记录中的 60 条对齐（占比不足 7%）。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval Effectiveness. For each system, we execute the original retrieval pipeline on summaries generated for the sampled test functions. We record the ranked knowledge items returned for each query and count a retrieval as relevant when the retrieved item matches the ground-truth CWE of the query function. To account for the hierarchical structure of CWE, we also consider a relaxed match in which parent or child CWE categories are treated as relevant. Hit@ k k therefore measures whether at least one relevant item appears among the top- k k results, while MRR captures the rank of the first such match. Figure 5 visualizes the results.
paragraphs.zh: 检索有效性。 对于每个系统，我们对采样测试函数生成的摘要执行原始的检索流程。 我们记录每次查询返回的排序知识项，并在检索到的项与查询函数的真实CWE匹配时，将该次检索视为相关。 为了考虑CWE的分层结构，我们还考虑了一种放宽的匹配方式，即父级或子级CWE类别也被视为相关。 因此，Hit@k衡量的是前k个结果中是否至少出现一个相关项，而MRR则捕捉到首个匹配项的排名。 图5展示了这些结果。

paragraphs.en: To establish an upper bound on retrieval, we construct an oracle setting in which the knowledge base is generated from the test set, guaranteeing that a ground-truth item is present in the retrieval pool. For Vul-RAG, oracle MRR is near-ceiling when the knowledge base and test set are aligned ( 0.93 0.93 for PairVul, 0.95 0.95 for PrimeVul), i.e., the retrieval mechanism can recover relevant knowledge effectively when sufficient task-aligned knowledge is available.

paragraphs.en: Detection under Oracle Knowledge. To approximate best-case upstream conditions, we use the test set-specific oracle knowledge bases. paragraphs.en: Across all three analyzed components, the results suggest that improving RAG4SVD requires optimizing the alignment between pipeline stages, rather than simply scaling models or knowledge bases. Abstraction quality is driven primarily by the system-specific summarization objective (Finding #3); retrieval effectiveness depends on query formulation and knowledge base alignment with the target distribution (Findings #4 and #5); and detection performance is influenced more by the alignment of the supplied knowledge than by knowledge base size or generator scale (Finding #6). Even where scaling does help, particularly at the detection stage, it closes only part of the gap: mean pairwise accuracy remains near 0.50 0.50 even under oracle knowledge (Finding #7).
paragraphs.zh: 在对所有三个分析组件的考察中，结果表明，改进 RAG4SVD 需要优化各流程阶段之间的对齐，而不仅仅是简单地扩大模型或知识库的规模。 抽象质量主要由系统特定的摘要目标决定（发现 #3）；检索有效性取决于查询构建方式以及知识库与目标分布的对齐程度（发现 #4 和 #5）；而检测性能则更多受到所提供知识对齐程度的影响，而非知识库规模或生成器规模（发现 #6）。 即使在扩大规模确实有帮助的情况下（尤其是在检测阶段），这也仅能部分弥合差距：即便在拥有理想知识的情况下，平均成对准确率仍接近 0.50 0.50（发现 #7）。

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity. We re-implemented and adapted existing RAG4SVD systems into a unified benchmark framework. Although we preserve system logic, prompts, and hyperparameters where possible, implementation differences, parser hardening, and model substitutions may affect reproduced results. We mitigate these risks by documenting all adaptations in the replication package and repeating experiments where applicable. All RAG4SVD inference pipelines use locally hosted open-weight models; the only remote dependency is the open-weight GPT-oss-120B judge used for the abstraction-quality analysis in RQ3.

paragraphs.en: Construct Validity. Pairwise accuracy provides a stricter measure of vulnerable-patched discrimination than instance-level metrics, while excluding configurations with fewer than 95% parseable predictions may favor systems with more robust output formats. We therefore report parsing success in the replication package. For retrieval, we define relevance by ground-truth CWE agreement, including parent/child relations. As CWE agreement does not necessarily imply semantic or vulnerability-specific relevance, we interpret these metrics as measuring knowledge alignment rather than actionable knowledge quality. The component analysis further relies on sampled test-set probes due to the computational cost of evaluating all model-knowledge base combinations, such that small differences may reflect sampling noise.
paragraphs.zh: 构建效度。 成对准确率比实例级指标更能严格衡量对漏洞与补丁的区分能力，但排除可解析预测率低于95%的配置，可能会使结果更偏向输出格式更稳健的系统。 因此，我们在复现包中报告了解析成功率。 在检索方面，我们通过真实CWE匹配情况来定义相关性，其中包含父/子关系。 由于CWE匹配并不必然意味着语义或特定漏洞的相关性，我们将这些指标解释为衡量知识一致性，而非可用知识的实际质量。 组件分析还依赖于从测试集中采样的探针，因为评估所有模型与知识库组合的计算成本较高，因此微小差异可能反映采样噪声。

paragraphs.en: External Validity. The findings and conclusions of this work are limited to the systems, datasets, and models considered. We study six artifact-complete RAG4SVD systems, use PrimeVul Paired as the common benchmark, and evaluate a documented pool of 3B-32B open-weight models suitable for on-premises deployment. paragraphs.en: In this work, we examined RAG-based software vulnerability detection from the perspectives of reproducibility, cross-system comparability, and component-level attribution. Across six open-source RAG4SVD systems, we find that reported results do not consistently transfer to open-weight evaluation settings, and that system rankings can change substantially under a unified benchmark. In the presented component analysis of representative RAG4SVD pipelines, we further dissected input abstraction, knowledge retrieval, and detection to identify where future RAG4SVD systems should focus their engineering effort. As abstraction quality, e.g., code summarization, is shaped by the system-specific prompting objective, input abstractions should be optimized for retrieval utility rather than conciseness. As retrieval effectiveness depends on knowledge base coverage and alignment with the target distribution, these properties should be established beforehand, since poor retrieval can limit detection performance. Finally, oracle retrieval does not solve vulnerability detection: oracle knowledge containing ground truth information achieves MRR of 0.93 0.93 – 0.95 0.95 , yet mean pairwise accuracy remains only 0.51 0.51 .
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们从可重复性、跨系统可比性和组件级归因等角度，研究了基于 RAG 的软件漏洞检测。 通过对六个开源的 RAG4SVD 系统的分析，我们发现所报告的结果无法稳定地迁移到开放权重的评估环境中，并且在统一基准测试下，各系统的排名可能会发生显著变化。 在对代表性 RAG4SVD 流程进行的组件分析中，我们进一步剖析了输入抽象、知识检索和检测环节，以明确未来 RAG4SVD 系统应将工程重点放在何处。 由于抽象质量（例如代码摘要）由系统特定的提示目标所决定，因此输入抽象应针对检索效用进行优化，而非追求简洁性。 检索的有效性取决于知识库的覆盖范围以及与目标分布的一致性，因此这些特性应提前确立，因为较差的检索能力可能会限制检测性能。 最后，即使采用“神谕”检索也无法解决漏洞检测问题：包含真实信息的“神谕”知识实现的 MRR 为 0.93–0.95，但平均成对准确率仅为 0.51。

paragraphs.en: Overall, these findings suggest that progress in RAG4SVD is unlikely to come from scaling individual components, such as models or knowledge bases, alone. Performance is governed by the alignment across component interfaces, e.g., abstraction to retrieval, knowledge base to target distribution, and retrieved knowledge to detector. Hence, future evaluations should complement end-to-end detection metrics with component-level evaluations of abstraction quality, knowledge base coverage, retrieval effectiveness, parsing robustness, and downstream knowledge use.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这些研究结果表明，RAG4SVD 的进步不太可能仅通过单独扩大模型或知识库等单个组件的规模来实现。 性能取决于各组件接口之间的对齐程度，例如，从抽象到检索、从知识库到目标分布，以及从检索到的知识到检测器的对齐。 因此，未来的评估应将端到端的检测指标与组件级别的评估相结合，后者包括抽象质量、知识库覆盖范围、检索有效性、解析鲁棒性以及下游知识使用情况的评估。

paragraphs.en: For the component-level analysis in RQ3, we construct sampled test sets that match the CWE distributions of the system-specific reference datasets. For Vul-RAG, we sample PrimeVul according to the ten CWEs represented in PairVul, selecting five instances per CWE where available. As PrimeVul contains only one CWE-264 instance, the resulting sample PrimeVul * PairVul {}_{\text{PairVul}} contains 46 vulnerable functions. For LLM4Vuln, we use the full UniVul test set as the reference distribution and sample PrimeVul to match its per-CWE counts where possible. This yields PrimeVul * UniVul {}_{\text{UniVul}} with 42 vulnerable functions across 18 overlapping CWEs. Tab. 4 summarizes the dataset and probe statistics as well as the knowledge base generation statistics.
